theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 33 群

items.colloc: arrive at the latest 最晚抵達 | finish at the latest 最晚完成
items.distinct: no later than 不遲於 | by the deadline 在截止日前
ex: Please submit the report by Friday at the latest.
請最晚在週五前提交報告。
We need to finish the task at the latest by noon.
我們最晚要在中午前完成任務。
The shipment should arrive at the latest on Tuesday.
貨運最晚應該會在週二抵達。

items.colloc: back away from the deal 放棄交易 | back away from the project 從專案中退出
items.distinct: pull out of 退出（協議或活動） | withdraw from 撤出（資金或職位）
ex: The investor decided to back away from the negotiation.
投資人決定從談判中退出。
Do not back away from the challenges you face.
不要在面對挑戰時退縮。
They had to back away from the initial agreement.
他們不得不撤回最初的協議。

items.colloc: open a bank account 開立帳戶 | close a bank account 結清帳戶
items.distinct: savings account 儲蓄帳戶 | checking account 支票帳戶
ex: Please deposit the payment into my bank account.
請將款項匯入我的銀行帳戶。
I need to update my bank account details today.
我今天需要更新銀行帳戶資料。
The company pays salaries via direct bank account transfer.
公司透過直接匯款至銀行帳戶發放薪資。

items.colloc: bargain over prices effectively 有效地議價 | refuse to bargain over prices 拒絕議價
items.distinct: negotiate a contract 協商合約 | haggle 討價還價（口語）
ex: Vendors are often willing to bargain over prices here.
這裡的攤販通常願意議價。
It is unprofessional to bargain over prices in this store.
在這家店討價還價是很不專業的。
We managed to bargain over prices to reduce costs.
我們成功透過議價降低了成本。

items.colloc: be determined to succeed 決心成功 | be determined to improve 決心改善
items.distinct: be set on doing 執意要做 | be resolved to do 下定決心做
ex: Our team is determined to finish the project ahead of time.
我們團隊決心提前完成專案。
The manager is determined to improve office efficiency.
經理決心提升辦公室效率。
They are determined to do whatever it takes to win.
他們決心不計代價取得勝利。

items.pos: phr. 備受推崇；評價很高
items.colloc: be highly regarded as 普遍被認為是 | be highly regarded by clients 備受客戶推崇
items.distinct: be well-known 知名的 | be reputable 有信譽的
ex: Dr. Lin is highly regarded in the engineering industry.
林博士在工程界備受推崇。
Our firm is highly regarded for its excellent services.
本公司因其優質服務而評價極高。
The new software is highly regarded by tech experts.
這套新軟體備受科技專家推崇。

items.colloc: be satisfied with the result 對結果滿意 | be satisfied with the service 對服務滿意
items.distinct: be pleased with 對...感到高興 | be content with 對...感到知足
ex: The client seems to be satisfied with our proposal.
客戶似乎對我們的提案感到滿意。
Are you satisfied with the current working conditions?
你對目前的辦公環境滿意嗎？
Management is not satisfied with the quarterly figures.
管理層對本季數據並不滿意。

items.colloc: please be seated 請就座 | everyone is seated 大家都已入座
items.distinct: sit down 坐下（動作） | take a seat 找位子坐
ex: Please be seated before the presentation begins.
請在簡報開始前就座。
All guests were seated by the time the dinner started.
晚餐開始時所有賓客都已入座。
Once you are seated, we will serve the beverages.
請您入座後，我們將為您上飲料。

items.colloc: be well suited for the job 非常適合這份工作 | be perfectly suited for the task 非常勝任這項任務
items.distinct: be fit for 適宜的 | be qualified for 有資格的
ex: He is well suited for a leadership position.
他非常適合擔任領導職位。
This software is suited for small business accounting.
這套軟體適合小型企業會計使用。
Not everyone is suited for a fast-paced environment.
並非每個人都適合節奏快速的環境。

items.colloc: believe it or not, it happened 信不信由你，這發生了 | believe it or not, we finished 信不信由你，我們完成了
items.distinct: to tell the truth 老實說 | as a matter of fact 事實上
ex: Believe it or not, we finished the report in one hour.
信不信由你，我們在一小時內完成了報告。
Believe it or not, the price dropped significantly today.
信不信由你，價格今天大幅下跌了。
Believe it or not, I have never been to that branch.
信不信由你，我從未去過那間分公司。

items.colloc: bring about change 帶來改變 | bring about success 促成成功
items.distinct: result in 導致 | give rise to 引起
ex: The new policy will bring about significant changes.
新政策將帶來重大的改變。
These measures aim to bring about a better work environment.
這些措施旨在創造更好的工作環境。
Innovation can bring about a competitive advantage.
創新能夠帶來競爭優勢。

items.colloc: bring along a guest 帶一位客人 | bring along the documents 攜帶文件
items.distinct: take along 帶走 | carry 搬運
ex: Please bring along your ID for the security check.
請攜帶您的證件以進行安全檢查。
You should bring along a notebook to the meeting.
你開會時應該隨身攜帶筆記本。
She decided to bring along her laptop for the trip.
她決定隨身攜帶筆記型電腦出差。

items.pos: n. 商務聯絡人；業務關係
items.colloc: develop business contacts 拓展業務人脈 | maintain business contacts 維繫業務關係
items.distinct: business associates 事業夥伴 | professional network 專業人脈網絡
ex: Networking helps you build valuable business contacts.
社交有助於你建立寶貴的商務人脈。
He has many business contacts in the Asian market.
他在亞洲市場擁有許多商務聯絡人。
I need to update my list of business contacts.
我需要更新我的商務聯絡人名單。

items.colloc: pay by credit card 用信用卡支付 | purchase by credit card 用信用卡購買
items.distinct: in cash 現金 | by bank transfer 匯款
ex: Customers can pay by credit card at the counter.
顧客可以在櫃檯使用信用卡結帳。
We do not accept payments by credit card for now.
我們目前不接受信用卡付款。
All online orders must be paid by credit card.
所有網路訂單都必須使用信用卡付款。

items.colloc: by no means easy 絕非容易 | by no means certain 絕非確定
items.distinct: not at all 一點也不 | far from 遠非
ex: The task is by no means as simple as it looks.
這項任務絕非看起來那麼簡單。
By no means should you share the confidential password.
你絕不應該分享這個機密密碼。
The project is by no means finished yet.
這項專案絕非已經完成了。

items.colloc: call back later 稍後回電 | promise to call back 保證會回電
items.distinct: return a call 回覆電話 | pick up 接聽電話
ex: The manager is in a meeting; I will call back.
經理正在開會，我會再回電。
Please ask him to call back after three o'clock.
請請他三點後回電。
I forgot to call back the client this morning.
我今天早上忘了回電給客戶。

items.colloc: book a charter plane 預訂包機 | use a charter plane 使用包機
items.distinct: commercial flight 民航機 | private jet 私人噴射機
ex: The company rented a charter plane for the executives.
公司為高層租用了一架包機。
A charter plane is faster than a regular flight.
包機比一般航班更快。
We are considering a charter plane for the group trip.
我們正在考慮為團隊旅行安排包機。

items.pos: phr. 完成交易；達成協議
items.colloc: successfully close a deal 成功成交 | help close a deal 協助完成交易
items.distinct: sign a contract 簽約 | reach an agreement 達成共識
ex: They finally managed to close a deal after long negotiations.
經過長時間談判，他們終於達成協議。
Our sales team is working hard to close a deal.
我們的業務團隊正努力爭取成交。
It took three months to close a deal with them.
花費了三個月才與他們達成交易。

items.colloc: come apart at the seams 接縫處裂開 | the device came apart 裝置散掉了
items.distinct: fall apart 解體 | break down 故障
ex: The cardboard box started to come apart during shipping.
紙箱在運輸過程中開始散開了。
If you pull it too hard, it will come apart.
如果你用力過猛，它就會散開。
The old machine is starting to come apart.
這台舊機器開始要散掉了。

items.colloc: count on someone to help 指望某人幫忙 | count on the result 指望結果
items.distinct: rely on 依賴 | depend on 取決於
ex: You can count on our team to deliver on time.
你可以指望我們的團隊準時交付。
We are counting on your support for this event.
我們指望你能為這次活動提供支持。
Never count on luck to succeed in business.
做生意永遠不要指望運氣成功。
